quests.instruction: Listen and tilt to yes if the audio matches the text, or no if it doesn't.
quests.hint: A change of plan is requested step by step. Follow the reason.
quests.explanation: You heard exactly what was written. "Come up" here means that something unexpected has happened, and "so" leads to the request.
quests.prompt: I know we agreed on Thursday, but something urgent has come up, so can we move it?
quests.sampleAnswer: I know we agreed on Thursday, but something urgent has come up, so can we move it?
quests.followUpQuestion: Ask to change a plan because something urgent has come up.

quests.instruction: Listen and tilt to yes if the audio matches the text, or no if it doesn't.
quests.hint: A misunderstanding about two entrances. Where is the second one?
quests.explanation: Round the back and round the corner give two different directions. A visitor would stand at the wrong door.
quests.prompt: Sorry for the confusion, I thought you meant the main entrance, not the one round the corner.
quests.sampleAnswer: Sorry for the confusion, I thought you meant the main entrance, not the one round the back.
quests.followUpQuestion: Clear up a misunderstanding about where to meet.

quests.instruction: Listen and tilt to yes if the audio matches the text, or no if it doesn't.
quests.hint: A traveller predicts arrival. How confident is the prediction?
quests.explanation: Should shows an expectation, and might shows real doubt. The person waiting would decide differently.
quests.prompt: If the flight lands on time, I might be at the hotel by six, but don't wait for me.
quests.sampleAnswer: If the flight lands on time, I should be at the hotel by six, but don't wait for me.
quests.followUpQuestion: Tell someone when you might arrive and when they shouldn't wait.

quests.instruction: Listen and tilt to yes if the audio matches the text, or no if it doesn't.
quests.hint: A request has a deadline and a question inside it.
quests.explanation: "Whether" introduces the yes-or-no question, and "still" suggests the plan may have changed.
quests.prompt: Could you let me know by the end of the day whether you're still able to attend?
quests.sampleAnswer: Could you let me know by the end of the day whether you're still able to attend?
quests.followUpQuestion: Ask someone to confirm they can still come, before a deadline.

quests.instruction: Listen and tilt to yes if the audio matches the text, or no if it doesn't.
quests.hint: The speaker rejects one explanation. Which adjective is rejected?
quests.explanation: Old and slow are different complaints. A manager would fix age with an upgrade and speed with tuning.
quests.prompt: The problem isn't that the software is old, it's that nobody knows how to use it properly.
quests.sampleAnswer: The problem isn't that the software is slow, it's that nobody knows how to use it properly.
quests.followUpQuestion: Say what the real problem is in a situation you know.

quests.instruction: Listen and tilt to yes if the audio matches the text, or no if it doesn't.
quests.hint: An apology is followed by an explanation of what was believed.
quests.explanation: "Must have" plus a past participle is used for a logical conclusion about the past.
quests.prompt: I'm really sorry, I must have misunderstood you, because I thought the party was next Saturday.
quests.sampleAnswer: I'm really sorry, I must have misunderstood you, because I thought the party was next Saturday.
quests.followUpQuestion: Apologise for misunderstanding a date and ask what's correct.

quests.instruction: Listen and tilt to yes if the audio matches the text, or no if it doesn't.
quests.hint: A choice has a downside after "even though".
quests.explanation: Customer service and delivery times are separate parts of a supplier's work, so the risk is different.
quests.prompt: We've decided to go with the cheaper supplier, even though their customer service is less reliable.
quests.sampleAnswer: We've decided to go with the cheaper supplier, even though their delivery times are less reliable.
quests.followUpQuestion: Explain a choice with an advantage and a drawback.

quests.instruction: Listen and tilt to yes if the audio matches the text, or no if it doesn't.
quests.hint: An alternative is suggested with "rather than".
quests.explanation: Nothing was altered in this one. "Rather than" is followed by an -ing form, and "just" makes the idea sound simple.
quests.prompt: Rather than driving all the way there, we could just have the meeting online.
quests.sampleAnswer: Rather than driving all the way there, we could just have the meeting online.
quests.followUpQuestion: Suggest a simpler way to hold a meeting.

quests.instruction: Listen and tilt to yes if the audio matches the text, or no if it doesn't.
quests.hint: A late discovery is told with a person at the end.
quests.explanation: Manager and colleague give a different picture. Being reminded by your boss is more worrying.
quests.prompt: I didn't realise the presentation was today until my manager reminded me this morning.
quests.sampleAnswer: I didn't realise the presentation was today until my colleague reminded me this morning.
quests.followUpQuestion: Say who reminded you about something, and how you felt.

quests.instruction: Listen and tilt to yes if the audio matches the text, or no if it doesn't.
quests.hint: An explanation is hedged with a phrase at the start.
quests.explanation: "As far as I can tell" shows the speaker isn't completely sure.
quests.prompt: As far as I can tell, the delay was caused by a signal failure near the junction.
quests.sampleAnswer: As far as I can tell, the delay was caused by a signal failure near the junction.
quests.followUpQuestion: Explain the reason for a delay, but say you're not completely sure.

quests.instruction: Listen and tilt to yes if the audio matches the text, or no if it doesn't.
quests.hint: A deal between colleagues includes when the favour will be returned.
quests.explanation: Next week and next month give a very different return timeline. It's a matter of how long you wait to be paid back.
quests.prompt: Would you be able to swap shifts with me on Friday if I cover for you next month?
quests.sampleAnswer: Would you be able to swap shifts with me on Friday if I cover for you next week?
quests.followUpQuestion: Propose a swap with a colleague and say when you'll return the favour.

quests.instruction: Listen and tilt to yes if the audio matches the text, or no if it doesn't.
quests.hint: A correction: first what didn't happen, then what did.
quests.explanation: "It turns out" introduces new information that changes the earlier belief.
quests.prompt: It turns out that the meeting wasn't cancelled, it was just moved to a different room.
quests.sampleAnswer: It turns out that the meeting wasn't cancelled, it was just moved to a different room.
quests.followUpQuestion: Correct something you believed earlier, using it turns out.

quests.instruction: Listen and tilt to yes if the audio matches the text, or no if it doesn't.
quests.hint: A preference is explained by a bad alternative. Where is the queue?
quests.explanation: Airport and border are both places where you queue, but they suggest a different kind of trip.
quests.prompt: Honestly, I'd rather pay a bit more than spend three hours queueing at the airport.
quests.sampleAnswer: Honestly, I'd rather pay a bit more than spend three hours queueing at the border.
quests.followUpQuestion: Say what you'd pay extra to avoid, and why.

quests.instruction: Listen and tilt to yes if the audio matches the text, or no if it doesn't.
quests.hint: Something didn't go to plan. Listen for the expectation and the reality.
quests.explanation: The recording follows the text word for word. "Was supposed to" shows the plan, and "hasn't even" adds surprise.
quests.prompt: The train was supposed to leave at ten, but it hasn't even arrived at the platform yet.
quests.sampleAnswer: The train was supposed to leave at ten, but it hasn't even arrived at the platform yet.
quests.followUpQuestion: Complain about a timetable that didn't work.

quests.instruction: Listen and tilt to yes if the audio matches the text, or no if it doesn't.
quests.hint: Criticism is softened by repeating "I'm saying". Follow the modal.
quests.explanation: "Might have been" plus a past participle speculates about the past without blame.
quests.prompt: I'm not saying you were wrong, I'm just saying it might have been handled differently.
quests.sampleAnswer: I'm not saying you were wrong, I'm just saying it might have been handled differently.
quests.followUpQuestion: Give gentle feedback about a decision that could have been handled differently.

quests.instruction: Listen and tilt to yes if the audio matches the text, or no if it doesn't.
quests.hint: The default assumption is decided by the last words.
quests.explanation: Cancelled and still on mean opposite things. Someone who assumes wrongly might skip an important meeting or turn up for nothing.
quests.prompt: If you don't hear from me by lunchtime, please assume the meeting is cancelled.
quests.sampleAnswer: If you don't hear from me by lunchtime, please assume the meeting is still on.
quests.followUpQuestion: Say what to assume if you don't hear back, and by when.

quests.instruction: Listen and tilt to yes if the audio matches the text, or no if it doesn't.
quests.hint: A request for repetition is justified in the second sentence.
quests.explanation: "I think I missed" softens the request and shows the reason.
quests.prompt: Would you mind explaining what happened again? I think I missed the beginning of the story.
quests.sampleAnswer: Would you mind explaining what happened again? I think I missed the beginning of the story.
quests.followUpQuestion: Ask someone to tell you the story again, politely.

quests.instruction: Listen and tilt to yes if the audio matches the text, or no if it doesn't.
quests.hint: The apology includes a promise with a time limit. Listen carefully to the number.
quests.explanation: Five and fifteen are a pair that's easy to confuse, and a customer would wait three times as long.
quests.prompt: They apologised for the mistake and offered to refund the difference within fifteen working days.
quests.sampleAnswer: They apologised for the mistake and offered to refund the difference within five working days.
quests.followUpQuestion: Say how long a refund can take, and what happens if it's late.

quests.instruction: Listen and tilt to yes if the audio matches the text, or no if it doesn't.
quests.hint: The sentence tells a story about a mistake. What was noticed, and when?
quests.explanation: This is a straight match. "By the time" is followed by a past tense, and "already" adds the feeling of lateness.
quests.prompt: By the time I realised I'd taken the wrong bus, we were already twenty minutes late.
quests.sampleAnswer: By the time I realised I'd taken the wrong bus, we were already twenty minutes late.
quests.followUpQuestion: Tell a story about taking the wrong route.

quests.instruction: Listen and tilt to yes if the audio matches the text, or no if it doesn't.
quests.hint: Someone hands over something that isn't perfect. Whose request was it?
quests.explanation: You and I show who made the request. Changing it changes who is disappointed.
quests.prompt: It's not exactly what you asked for, but I suppose it will do for now.
quests.sampleAnswer: It's not exactly what I asked for, but I suppose it will do for now.
quests.followUpQuestion: Hand over a second-best option politely.

quests.instruction: Listen and tilt to yes if the audio matches the text, or no if it doesn't.
quests.hint: A check of understanding names a deadline and then a second one.
quests.explanation: This week and next week are different. Confirming the wrong one means missing a deadline.
quests.prompt: Just so we're clear, you'd like the report by Monday, not the end of this week?
quests.sampleAnswer: Just so we're clear, you'd like the report by Monday, not the end of next week?
quests.followUpQuestion: Check a deadline with a colleague, so there's no mix-up.

quests.instruction: Listen and tilt to yes if the audio matches the text, or no if it doesn't.
quests.hint: The caller explains a problem with a payment method.
quests.explanation: Card and account are related but different things. The customer would check something different.
quests.prompt: The reason I'm calling is that we've noticed an unusual charge on your card.
quests.sampleAnswer: The reason I'm calling is that we've noticed an unusual charge on your account.
quests.followUpQuestion: Explain why you're calling a customer.

quests.instruction: Listen and tilt to yes if the audio matches the text, or no if it doesn't.
quests.hint: A plan has an exception at the start.
quests.explanation: "Unless" means "if not", so the plan holds as long as nothing changes.
quests.prompt: Unless there's a change at the last minute, I'll pick you up from the station around six.
quests.sampleAnswer: Unless there's a change at the last minute, I'll pick you up from the station around six.
quests.followUpQuestion: Say what will happen unless something changes.

quests.instruction: Listen and tilt to yes if the audio matches the text, or no if it doesn't.
quests.hint: Advice begins with a hypothetical.
quests.explanation: "If I were you" is the standard way to give advice, and it uses "were" for all persons.
quests.prompt: If I were you, I'd check the address twice before you order, just to be safe.
quests.sampleAnswer: If I were you, I'd check the address twice before you order, just to be safe.
quests.followUpQuestion: Give a friend advice using If I were you.

quests.instruction: Listen and tilt to yes if the audio matches the text, or no if it doesn't.
quests.hint: A contrast between experience and attitude. Listen to how many candidates seemed keen.
quests.explanation: Both and one are different counts. "Both" says neither candidate needed persuading, and "one" says only one of them was keen.
quests.prompt: Neither of the candidates had much experience in the field, but both seemed keen to learn quickly.
quests.sampleAnswer: Neither of the candidates had much experience in the field, but one seemed keen to learn quickly.
quests.followUpQuestion: Say how you feel about learning something new, and what makes it easier.

quests.instruction: Listen and tilt to yes if the audio matches the text, or no if it doesn't.
quests.hint: A comforting message has an apology and a hope.
quests.explanation: Listening and reading agree here. "Come along" means to appear or happen in time.
quests.prompt: I'm sorry to hear you didn't get the job, but I'm sure something better will come along.
quests.sampleAnswer: I'm sorry to hear you didn't get the job, but I'm sure something better will come along.
quests.followUpQuestion: Comfort someone who didn't get something they wanted.

quests.instruction: Listen and tilt to yes if the audio matches the text, or no if it doesn't.
quests.hint: Two options are presented, then a final claim. Listen to the modal in that claim.
quests.explanation: Can't means it is impossible, and shouldn't means it is possible but unwise. With the second, the team still has a choice.
quests.prompt: We can either extend the deadline or reduce the scope, but we can't do both.
quests.sampleAnswer: We can either extend the deadline or reduce the scope, but we shouldn't do both.
quests.followUpQuestion: Present two options and say you can't have both.

quests.instruction: Listen and tilt to yes if the audio matches the text, or no if it doesn't.
quests.hint: A decision is made after collecting opinions. Watch the preposition before the day.
quests.explanation: On Monday means that day exactly, and before Monday means earlier. It changes the whole schedule for a meeting.
quests.prompt: Having spoken to everyone involved, I think it's best if we all sit down together before Monday.
quests.sampleAnswer: Having spoken to everyone involved, I think it's best if we all sit down together on Monday.
quests.followUpQuestion: Propose a meeting time to a group and explain why.

quests.instruction: Listen and tilt to yes if the audio matches the text, or no if it doesn't.
quests.hint: Understanding is shown first, then another view. Listen to the second half.
quests.explanation: No change. "On purpose" means deliberately, and "but" introduces the contrast.
quests.prompt: I can see why you were annoyed, but I don't think he did it on purpose.
quests.sampleAnswer: I can see why you were annoyed, but I don't think he did it on purpose.
quests.followUpQuestion: Defend a colleague politely when others are annoyed.

quests.instruction: Listen and tilt to yes if the audio matches the text, or no if it doesn't.
quests.hint: A rule follows the word "whatever". What must happen?
quests.explanation: "Whatever" means it doesn't matter which decision, and the rule always applies.
quests.prompt: Whatever we decide, we should make sure that everyone hears about it at the same time.
quests.sampleAnswer: Whatever we decide, we should make sure that everyone hears about it at the same time.
quests.followUpQuestion: Say what you would make sure everyone hears, whatever is decided.
